architecture.flow: UI -> M03 facade -> unique M04 DocumentOwner -> IO/M05 ports <- driven adapters
architecture.ownership: S1 owns content/history/baselines; issuer retained capture/proofs are derived application records, not new document SSOT. IO owns private journal; M05 owns retention receipts.
architecture.transaction: Capture semantic state -> verified file receipt -> verified root receipt -> captured semantic ACK -> authorized delivery. Failure after file commit never means rollback.

new_choices: Strict U64 end assertion (?![\s\S]) and min/maxLength; checker has no U64 semantic override.
Trusted issuer_record.sealed_capture is immutable server-owned evidence, inaccessible to caller mutation; fixture model does not prove actual isolation/authenticity.

Post-file sealed transaction identity binds actual IO transaction_id; initial pre-IO capture must not fabricate a receipt. This is model evidence after receipt, not a new persistent transaction or restart guarantee.

Sealed capture includes project/document/session/generation/request/operation/issuer/revision/semantic/newraw/previousraw/native target/pin/material pair set/formal root/projector identity. Root and ACK carry exact derived bindings in this review-local evidence model, not a new public Port DTO.

Material proof uses exact pair set (asset_id,content_digest), duplicate pairs and malformed records reject; order is irrelevant and canonical UTF8(asset_id),ASCII(digest) sorting applies. Multiple distinct versions of same asset remain distinct pairs.
Late detach/authorization or owner mismatch yields server retained deferred evidence, no ACK or unauthorized UI delivery. Current live revision may be newer; no rollback/forced clean.
prior_policies: 57 defensive MaterialError pairs and four SemanticAck deferred wire branches copied unchanged from prior candidate; not proof of runtime reachability/adoption.
remaining: Separate document semantic review and Owner adoption
Integrate agreed model evidence shape with exact issuer/projector/provider implementation envelope; fixture trusted flags are not production authenticity proof
review_limits: Issuer verified is a fixture capability flag for an already trusted server record; neither cryptographic provenance nor runtime immutability is proven.
Sealed record is post-file evidence; transaction_id is copied only from actually verified receipt. No initial capture invented transaction ID.
This evidence-model internal projection does not silently extend existing public CommitReceipt/Port or actual M05 receipt schema. Those effective contract mappings require review/adoption.
Canonical material-set duplicate/order policy is new precise candidate policy, not auto-adopted behavior.
Document model returns no response body to unauthorized current owner; deferred evidence stays server-side. Actual delivery authorization and runtime suppression require future tests.
